messages.subject: Tamarisk — strategy on royalty / cap / minimum
messages.plaintextBody:
James, Elena,

Northstar have landed on 4.5% royalty and a 2x cap. Anders is fine with both. The trade I want to extract for conceding the rate is to lift the minimum annual royalty from £350k to £500k from Year 3 — that protects Halverson's downside if volumes are slow. Elena, please prepare v3 with that single change tracked and the 4.5%/2x/longstop changes accepted clean.

Sarah
